title: INTERNSHIP - Talent Acquisition
full_description:
Luxembourg, Luxembourg
Starting March 2026 | 6‑month internship minimum | School convention required
At ING Luxembourg, we’re building a workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued, and empowered to contribute. We warmly encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including LGBTQIA+ individuals, people from diverse communities, and applicants with disabilities or neurodiverse conditions.
We’re now looking for a curious, motivated intern to join ourTalent Acquisition Team. If you're excited about recruitment, eager to learn how HR works from the inside, and ready to contribute to projects that shape the employee experience, this internship is for you.
While your main focus will be onrecruitment and onboarding, you will also get a glimpse into ING’s broader strategic HR topics such as talent management, learning & development, and employee engagement.
As part of our HR department, you will contribute to the smooth experience of candidates, trainees, and new joiners. You’ll also support several HR initiatives that play a key role in growing our people and culture.
Participate in the full recruitment cycle for trainees: meet managers, draft and publish job offers, screen CVs, conduct HR interviews, and coordinate follow‑up with hiring managers.
Support the onboarding of new joiners: prepare agreements, manage administrative steps, welcome newcomers, and contribute to onboarding presentations.
Assist with operational recruitment activities: mailbox management, security checks, interview logistics, and more.
Manage administrative tasks with care and accuracy: form handling, document collection, employee file updates.
Help organize HR events and initiatives such asRecruitment Forums with UniversitiesandBusiness Schools.
You’ll collaborate closely with theHead of Talent & Learningon internal communication activities and campaigns linked to internal mobility, including creative work using tools likeCanva, PowerPointor AI‑driven platforms.
Highly organized, attentive to detail, and reliable.
Curious and eager to learn.
Strong writing skills and excellent interpersonal communication.
Comfortable working both independently and collaboratively.
Good command of MS Office (Word,Excel, Access, PowerPoint).
Knowledge of visual communication tools (Canva, SharePoint...) is areal plus.
You are aBachelor’s or Master’s studentin business, economics, human sciences, law, or a related field.
Previous experience in HR is appreciated butnot required.
Students passionate about marketing, communication, or web design are also welcome — your creativity will be valued!
Good knowledge ofFrenchandEnglishis required.
You’ll learn by doing, not by watching.
You'll work in a supportive and caring HR team that values initiative and authenticity.
You’ll get meaningful exposure to the realities of modern HR in a dynamic international bank.
Your ideas will matter — from improving candidate experience to enhancing internal communication.
Your working environment
With over 900 employees in the Grand Duchy and thanks to the combination of our local presence and the strength of a robust multinational like ING, we offer our business customers a wide range of solutions through the channel of their choice.
ING is a global bank with a strong European base. 53,000 employees serve around38.4 million customers, corporateclientsand financial institutions in over 40 countries. Operating in the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg since 1960 as a universal and accessible bank, our products include savings, payments, investments,loansand mortgages for private banking customers, whom we sever serve online and through our network of branches. For our Wholesale Banking clients, we provide lending, sustainable finance, payment & cashmanagementand fund services.
ING’s vision is to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop and have impact for our customers and society. To achieve this vision, our policies support diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind with regard to age, gender, gender identity, cultural background, experience, religion, race, ethnicity, disability, family responsibilities, sexual orientation, social origin, or any other status protected by applicable law. If you require any assistance or if we can accommodate you in any way when participating in our application and/or interview process, please email the recruiting contact listed for the relevant position. We will be happy to work with you to ensure a fair and accessible process. Read more about our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging here.
